common:
Cinematic sci-fi film still, 16:9, photoreal deep space, very dark background with rich true-black, subtle film grain.
A minimal diegetic holographic interface drawn as thin lines of light directly in 3D space ��
no screens, no panels, no cockpit or window frame, no glowing buttons, no rounded cards.
Hairline 1px strokes, ice-white (#DDEBFF) with sparse cyan (#6FE3FF) accents and a single amber (#FFB45A) highlight for the target.
Sparse elegant typography with wide letter spacing, thin geometric sans-serif and monospaced numerals, lots of negative space.
Inspired by the interface design of the films Oblivion (2013), Blade Runner 2049 and The Expanse. Premium, restrained, quiet, high-end.

shots.name: 01_neighborhood
shots.base_prompt:
First-person view into deep space from a starship bridge (no visible cockpit). Floating in front of the viewer at true 3D depth:
the local stellar neighborhood as a sparse constellation of tiny points of light, each with a hairline leader line and a very small label.
At the center a tiny marker reading "SOL". One thin circular ring of light expanding outward from the center of view.
Only a handful of labels, calm and uncluttered.

shots.name: 02_route
shots.base_prompt:
The same holographic star constellation in 3D space. One star highlighted in amber with a thin circular reticle;
all other stars dimmed. A luminous amber route line arcs through space from the "SOL" marker to the amber star,
with tiny tick marks at regular intervals along it and one small label at mid-route: "4.37 LY".
Depth of field, the route line recedes in perspective.

shots.name: 03_lock
shots.base_prompt:
Real starfield ahead, the hologram is gone. A thin amber targeting reticle (two corner brackets and a fine circle)
locks onto one bright star in the real sky. Next to it, two short lines of tiny text set like a film title:
"LIGHT: 4.37 YEARS" and "US: ~4 MONTHS". Nothing else on screen.

shots.name: 04_charge
shots.base_prompt:
Third-person shot from behind and above a long dark angular battleship with two large ring-shaped warp drives near its middle.
The ring segments are partially lit in cold blue. A thin holographic arc gauge floats in 3D just outside one ring,
following its curvature in perspective, with a tiny percentage readout "72%". No screen-space panels.

shots.name: 05_countdown
shots.base_prompt:
The same battleship from behind and above, warp rings fully charged and glowing.
In the space just ahead of the bow floats a very thin, tall holographic numeral "2", drawn with hairlines and set in 3D perspective,
slightly transparent. The ring segments show a countdown pattern: one third dark, two thirds bright.

shots.name: 06_ftl_gates
shots.base_prompt:
The battleship seen from behind at faster-than-light speed; ahead, a starbow �� the stars compressed into a rainbow ring around the direction of travel.
Faint holographic "distance gates" �� thin rectangular frames of light placed in space at intervals along the flight path ��
streaming toward and past the camera, each tagged with a tiny label like "2.5 LY". At the left screen edge a single large, very thin numeral "13.0 c".

shots.name: 07_arrival
shots.base_prompt:
The battleship hovering just above the surface of an enormous blue-white star: a curved glowing horizon across the lower half of the frame,
granulated plasma surface, a tall prominence arching above the horizon far larger than the ship, the ship as a dark silhouette against the light.
A single hairline leader line from the star to a small elegant two-line label: "ALPHA CENTAURI A" / "4.37 LY �� 117 DAYS". Dark space above.

variant_direction: Second composition variant; restrained hairlines and dark negative space. For ship shots emphasize exactly two hoop warp rings around mid hull; no planets. Route target ALPHA CENTAURI; gate labels 0.5–4.37 LY.
note: Generated images are composition references only. Text, distances, ring animation and final spacecraft geometry are authored by code.
